evals.prompt: 把这篇现有内容写成微信公众号 HTML 草稿，保存到真实草稿箱，并验证保存结果。
evals.expected_output: Derives the WeChat payload, runs deterministic local checks first, drives the authenticated real mp.weixin.qq.com editor, records the real draft identifier/save state, attempts reopen verification, probes a nearby edge case, and reports only evidence-backed states with one verdict.
expectations: Runs the repository publishing verifier before platform interaction
Uses the real WeChat Official Account editor or official API rather than only a local preview
Does not equate save, reopen verification, publish submission, and publication
Records platform evidence such as appmsgid/save state without exposing cookies or tokens
Reports exactly one of PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED, or SKIP for the requested verification claim

evals.prompt: 把同一篇文章改写成小红书版本，保留版本记录，先做草稿和预览，不要假装已经发布。
evals.expected_output: Creates a provenance-preserving RedNote draft and preview, runs the local verifier, clearly labels the preview as not published, and reports rednote-derived/local verification without inventing a platform publication state.
expectations: Preserves source provenance and version history
Labels preview/draft artifacts as not published
Does not claim rednote-draft-saved or rednote-published without real platform evidence

evals.prompt: 微信后台已经显示“已保存”，但重新打开草稿正文的检查被安全层挡住了。这个任务算什么状态？
evals.expected_output: Keeps wechat-draft-saved as the highest proven state, marks reopen verification as BLOCKED/not claimed, does not claim publication, and explains the evidence boundary without a partial pass.
expectations: Treats a real appmsgid plus 已保存 as draft-save evidence
Does not upgrade to wechat-draft-verified when reopen verification was not completed
Uses PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/SKIP discipline with no partial pass

evals.prompt: Gallery 里已经出现这篇小红书内容了，可以直接说发布成功吗？
evals.expected_output: Rejects the gallery/preview as publication proof and requires a real platform note URL or note ID before claiming rednote-published.
expectations: Treats the gallery as a mirror/test harness, not the canonical platform state
Requires a real RedNote/Xiaohongshu publication identifier or URL
